data.name: Beak Peak
data.detailed_description:
Clock in at the National Park!

You’ve just become the very first Ranger of Beak Peak National Park. Peace doesn't last long here; between the flocking Visitors and the quirky Locals, the island is always buzzing. You can take it slow with a stroll and a coffee, or keep things tidy by staying on top of patrols. Beak Island is now in your hands.

Park life is busier than you’d think! 🌴

Patrolling, picking up trash, and… Shape Up those unruly Visitors. Show those rule-breakers who’s boss! You can use the fines you collect to make the park even more beautiful—and don’t forget to keep honing your enforcement skills along the way.

Island life is better with neighbors 🐦

Mingle with the Locals. Before you know it, you’ll be part of this delightfully loose-knit community. As you get closer, their secrets and wacky plans will slowly unfold. Don’t laugh—they’re dead serious about their nonsense.

Shall we grab a bite first? 🍕

A Ranger’s salary can be a bit tight. That’s where a little extra income on the side comes in! Use ingredients gathered during your patrols to cook up something tasty. If you display them outside the Visitor Center, no hungry Visitor will be able to walk past.

Actually, Beak Island was a massive mine long ago ⛏️

Beak Peak National Park is mostly peaceful, but stay sharp. You never know what’s lurking at the end of those collapsed mine tunnels. Going in? Just make sure your stomach is full first.

Game Features

  • Exploration: Boost your stamina and learn new movement skills to find the island's hidden spots.

  • Gathering: Collect various ingredients that appear with the ebb and flow of tides and the cycle of day and night.

  • Park Expansion: Repair trails and install amenities to expand the park for your Visitors.

  • Character Creator: Design your one-and-only character, from facial features to outfits, reflecting your unique style.

  • Decorating: Use furniture you've crafted yourself and decorations to freely style your home and the entire island.

  • Collection: Complete your encyclopedia by recording Visitors and ecological data found on the island.

Meet the Devs

Hello! Beak Peak is the first game from a husband who left the corporate game industry to dream of his own world, and his wife, who somehow found herself along for the ride. In this little world we’ve argued our way through and worked hard to create, there are no complex strategies to memorize or intense controls to master. We’d be happy if this could be a space where you can comfortably settle in at the end of a long day and think, “Should I play for a bit?”
